introduced_findings.title: Decorative icon overlaps exercise name at MAX text size

evidence.frame_detail: First result icon x=22.3..86.0, y=338.7..375.7; Korean exercise-name text x=80.0..309.3, y=294.3..419.6. Frames intersect by 6.0pt horizontally and 37.0pt vertically. Screenshot visibly places dumbbell over the wrapped name.

introduced_findings.cause: New .subheadline SF Symbol scales at accessibility MAX while the row reserves only a 28pt icon frame. The icon was introduced in this B07 diff.
introduced_findings.bounded_fix: Keep the same resolvedActivityType.iconName and accent treatment, but use a fixed decorative SF Symbol font around 18pt inside the 28pt frame (or reserve enough width for its measured MAX size); confirm the same searched row with fresh MAX capture.

observations.result: Normal top controls and MAX first controls/final section are legible with wrapping and no observed overlap in inspected frames. MAX selector passed. Does not establish all middle sections.

Normal configured/all/search rows retain distinct activity icons, full visible Korean names, and chevrons. The 72.5 kg configured row is a diagnostic frame from a failed selector; MAX search row has the P2 overlap above.

Normal editor preserves labels, icons, switches, Save. Passed MAX saved reopen frame shows 72.5 and 8 in separate readable fields, with no observed row overlap. MAX focused selector passed on retry; separate save/reopen selector failed.

Filtered normal frame shows the original equipment icons and the selected native switch visually ON. It is diagnostic from a selector that failed later at screen reentry, so persistence is not passed.
